en.text:
Light Attack Hits grant 10% Sword Energy. Kills grant 30%. Kills or 3 Light Attack Hits spawn 3 Nanites.

Heavy Attacks with at least 10% Sword Energy consume 3 ammo and launch a Solar Wave that travels 10 meters. Aerial Heavy Attacks always spawn a wave.

Wolfsbane's damage is increased against enemies with <yellow Outbreak Perfected /> Nanites on them, <bold up to /> a maximum increase of 25% at maximum Outbreak nanites.

Nanites restore ? HP as they attach to you.
